title: A One-Inch Sea Slug Steals Venom From a Man O' War

scenes.text: A one-inch slug steals the venom of its prey.
The blue dragon eats the Portuguese man o' war.
It keeps the stinging cells and stores them in its fingertips.
The man o' war's own venom doesn't hurt it.
Because it stacks many cells, its sting can be stronger than the original.
It floats upside down on the ocean using a gas bubble in its stomach.
So yes: a slug that steals its weapons.

description:
A one-inch slug steals the venom of its prey.
The blue dragon eats the Portuguese man o' war, keeps its stinging cells, and can deliver a stronger sting than the original.
Would you pick one up on the beach?
first_comment: Bonus: it floats on its back, so its blue side faces the sky. Why is its underside silver?
